content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(DeviceVendor)
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct
| extend Status = iff(LastSeen >= ago(15m), "Healthy", "No Recent Data")
| order by Events desc
content.title: Fortigate DCR Health

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Computers = dcount(Computer)
| extend Status = iff(LastSeen >= ago(15m), "Healthy", "No Recent Data")
| project Computers, Events, LastSeen, Status
content.title: Cisco DCR Health

content.query:
let start = ago(24h);
let end = now();

union withsource=LogTable *
| where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
| summarize Events = count() by EventTime = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend EPS = round(todouble(Events) / 300.0, 2)
| project EventTime, EPS
| order by EventTime asc
content.title: Total EPS

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize
    WeeklyUsageGB = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0
    by DataType
| order by WeeklyUsageGB desc
| project
    TableName = DataType,
    WeeklyUsageGB
| render barchart
content.title: Weekly Average Table Usage

content.query:
let CurrentStart = startofday(now());
let PreviousStart = startofday(ago(1d));
let PreviousPreviousStart = startofday(ago(2d));

let Today =
    Usage
    | where StartTime >= CurrentStart
    | where EndTime <= now()
    | summarize Today = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 by DataType;

let Yesterday =
    Usage
    | where StartTime >= PreviousStart
    | where EndTime < CurrentStart
    | summarize Yesterday = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 by DataType;

Today
| join kind=fullouter Yesterday on DataType
| extend
    Table = coalesce(DataType, DataType1),
    Today = round(coalesce(Today, 0.0), 3),
    Yesterday = round(coalesce(Yesterday, 0.0), 3)
| extend
    GBdrop = round(Today - Yesterday, 3),
    PercentageDifference = iff(
        Yesterday > 0,
        round(((Today - Yesterday) / Yesterday) * 100, 2),
        0.0
    ),
    Change = case(
        Today > Yesterday, "Increased",
        Today < Yesterday, "Decreased",
        "No Change"
    )
| project
    Table,
    Yesterday,
    Today,
    GBdrop,
    PercentageDifference,
    Change
| order by abs(GBdrop) desc
content.title: Today VS Yesterday
